At 3two1, We’re crazy for a good Pina Colada, And Black Tears certainly delivers.  This Spiced Cuban Rum is all you really need to transform your everyday Pina Colada. Giffard have also made it easy to elevate the profile of your cocktail, with an extensive catalogue, it’s never been easier to delight and elate your guests. Why should you use Black Tears? 👉 Perfect blend of Cacao, Coffee and spice. 👉 Hand-crafted Cuban heritage is reflected in every bottle. 👉 Its freaking delicious! Black Tears Pina Colada: 45ml Black Tears Cuban Spiced Rum 20ml Giffard Coconut Syrup 60ml Fresh Pineapple Juice 20ml Fresh Lime Juice Shake, Double strain and garnish with mint. Enjoy!
